title: Blueprint change request
description: The whatif→map handoff contract. A whatif analysis the human accepts becomes ONE of these; map-promote consumes it, verifying base_signoff_hashes still match the workspace before touching the IR — a mismatch means the blueprint moved since the analysis, so promote refuses or re-traces. Transport: a workspace file in local dev (changes/<key>.json), a downloaded JSON from deployed builds.

key.description: Stable slug for this change request; also its filename.

source.description: v1: only whatif emits change requests.

base_signoff_hashes.description: scenario_key -> sign-off content hash at analysis time. The staleness guard: map-promote refuses on any mismatch.

finding_fingerprints.description: The whatif findings this request supersedes; map-promote auto-resolves them after import (its one sanctioned findings.status write).

diff.description: Ordered edit list against the IR — cell-key-addressed, never DB ids.

fields.description: For update/add ops: the IR fields being set (locale maps as in ir-schema).

position.description: For structural ops: where (step/lane/path key context).

note.description: Why this edit, citing the analysis — no excerpts.
